passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset your Cooking Assistant password.
passwordReset.footer: This link expires in 30 minutes. If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

verification.subject: Verify your email
verification.heading: Verify your email
verification.body: Confirm your email address to enable password reset on your Cooking Assistant account.
verification.footer: This link expires in 24 hours. If you didn't create this account, you can safely ignore this email - nothing happens until it's opened.
